name: Technology Consultant
target: Consulting and solution-engineering roles where delivery outranks stack.

content.summary: Technology consultant who scopes AI programmes and then delivers them. Authored the AI scope and feasibility assessment for the Prime Minister Internship Scheme — a 144 person-month programme for the Ministry of Corporate Affairs — and personally built five platforms now running in government production, including a citizen-facing assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in and a drafting system piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Works the full arc: stakeholder scoping, feasibility and estimation, solution architecture, delivery and cost engineering.

skills.label: Cloud & DevOps
items: Azure (App Service, Managed Redis, Service Bus)

experience.employer: EY (deployed to National e-Governance Division, MeitY)
experience.context: Lead a team of 4 interns and 1 analyst. Technology and AI advisory for Government of India digital programmes — Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, and Sports Authority of India.

blocks.title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme — AI programme scoping · Ministry of Corporate Affairs

bullets.text: Authored the 12,000-word AI Scope Document (14 sections, 24 tables, graded source register) and a 14-page Feasibility Assessment rating 22 interventions on a four-tier rubric — consolidating 19 use cases into 8 features on 6 shared building blocks and reconciling a 144 person-month estimate the source note had left unexplained.

Designed the delivery model: five phases governed by five data gates, a three-tier data-access contingency so delivery proceeds without portal source code, an equity-preservation constraint with rollback triggers, and ten decisions escalated to the Ministry — four of them Phase-1 blocking.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AWS Bedrock platform piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session, grounding official replies in 702 prior tabled Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers with per-sentence citations.

Delivered against NeGD SOP, ISO 27001 and CMMI L3 targets under a spec-driven SDLC: 312 tests green, SAST closed at zero critical findings, and a GIGW / WCAG 2.2 AA pre-audit with 15 of 23 findings remediated.

experience.context: Oracle Cloud Partner — 20+ enterprise clients including Aditya Birla Group, Adani, and Acko.

bullets.text: Architected a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AWS EC2 + Nginx, cutting deploy time 80% (15 min to under 3) with zero-downtime rolling releases, saving ~2 hrs of manual effort per cycle.

Engineered a real-time inventory backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) automating 3 reconciliation workflows, eliminating ~4 hrs/day of ops overhead, and consolidating 15+ scattered permission checks into one JWT RBAC middleware layer.

experience.context: Ed-tech platform delivering courses in web development, ML, and embedded systems to students across India.

bullets.text: Reduced frontend render latency by ~28% on a live multi-user ML platform (React DevTools Profiler) via React.memo and lazy loading — zero backend changes, zero regressions.
Built vendor-agnostic normalisation adapters over third-party ML APIs, fully decoupling business logic from vendor schemas and making future API swaps non-breaking.

projects.title: Medical Assistant Chatbot — Production RAG Pipeline   Python · LangChain · pgvector · FastAPI · Streamlit · OpenAI

bullets.text: Delivered a production-ready RAG system over medical knowledge bases: PDF ingestion → semantic chunking → pgvector cosine retrieval → citation-grounded LLM answer via streaming FastAPI endpoint.
